title: Project Strike · 战术漫画界面
style: Production game UI artwork for one coherent 2D military comic game. Hand inked clean outlines, restrained angular cel shading, matte midnight navy and desaturated blue grey painted steel, fine warm grey edge wear, tiny muted turquoise indicator lights. Flat front view, orthographic, crisp shapes, understated professional game art, no photorealism, no 3D render, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. Quiet readable surfaces, no busy patterns, no neon glow.

assets.name: 指挥室背景
assets.prompt: Panoramic illustrated military command room, massive blue grey steel beams frame the edges, muted cyan map screens and small warm amber lamps on the far right. Spacious shadowy center and left with very little detail for interface content. Wide establishing environment painting, cinematic atmosphere but readable flat comic shapes, no characters.

assets.name: 战役沙盘背景
assets.prompt: Panoramic illustrated tabletop tactical map, dark navy map surface occupies most of the center, subtle topographic contour lines and only a few tiny amber route pins near far right. Cropped metal map case corners and restrained military props only at outer edges. Empty dark left and middle for mission cards, horizontal graphic game menu environment.

assets.name: 军械库背景
assets.prompt: Wide illustrated military armory workbench bay, empty center platform framed by navy steel weapon lockers on both edges, modest warm overhead work lamp and muted turquoise strips, dark quiet central wall for presenting equipment and soldiers. Clean comic illustration, no people, no floating interface, no text.

assets.name: 通用内容面板
assets.prompt: One square blank game interface panel filling the ENTIRE canvas edge to edge. A narrow illustrated steel frame confined to outermost 6 percent, small squared reinforced corners, sparse tiny bolts in corners only. Center 88 percent is completely empty uniform very dark navy painted metal. Straight rectangular edges touch all four canvas boundaries, no surrounding background, no inset floating object, no compartments.

assets.name: 暂停与结算面板
assets.prompt: One square blank command briefing interface panel fills canvas edge to edge. Thin warm grey steel rim, slightly reinforced industrial corners, short muted amber accent in upper left border only. Center 88 percent uniform very dark navy, entirely empty and flat for readable text. Border confined to outermost 6 percent. No inner divisions, no objects, no surrounding scene.
